scope: Paper B v1.1 draft: all-query threshold root, exact sharing, and whole-paper coverage including constructed width and weighted deletion-cover corollaries.

repository_mode.extension_workspace: RESEARCH-FIRST; extract only after selected surfaces stabilize

milestones.title: Freeze scope, statement surface and build environment
milestones.exit_gate: A small, approved graph/RAM contract and a reproducible supported toolchain; no theorem proof inferred from setup.

milestones.title: Graph semantics, normalization and dominators
milestones.exit_gate: A finite explicit DAG model, failure semantics and actual preprocessing contracts.

milestones.title: Two-failure residual kernel
milestones.exit_gate: An executable kernel answers arbitrary original targets and tests proper cuts, with proved construction charges.

milestones.title: Threshold scheduler correctness
milestones.exit_gate: Every original query receives its exact Boolean answer; direct positives, kernel positives and negatives, root arrivals and final negatives are covered.

milestones.title: End-to-end time and workspace
milestones.exit_gate: All-query Theorem 3.2: one implemented vector solver, complete scan/target/construction charges and peak live words.

milestones.title: Exact historical-set sharing
milestones.exit_gate: Proposition 3.3, plus explicit representation examples, with its original time bound.

milestones.title: Common anchors and structural algorithms
milestones.exit_gate: Section4 plus constructed-width4.7 and weighted-cover4.8; discovery and OPT scope remain explicit.

milestones.title: Explicit reductions and conditional bounds
milestones.exit_gate: Source reductions, sizes and construction costs, followed by precisely conditional machine-model consequences.

milestones.title: Remaining baselines, summaries and controller interface
milestones.exit_gate: Appendices A–D and Corollary 6.1 with each imported input and resource gap exposed.

milestones.title: Fidelity, replay and release handoff
milestones.exit_gate: Per-statement paper/Lean comparison, clean reproducible checks and an exact user-controlled registration packet.

tasks.title: Pin the active draft and published baseline
tasks.obligation: Bind the v1.1 draft, its 32-entry statement inventory and companions, preserving the published v1.0 source/PDF lock.
acceptance: Published v1.0 PDF/source identities remain protected.
The active v1.1 draft and 32 statement/proof blocks are hashed separately; no v1.1 PDF or DOI is asserted.

tasks.title: Audit existing Lean and registry reuse
tasks.obligation: Separate local B01 evidence, registered Paper A inputs, obsolete board entries and missing replay environment.
acceptance: Historical successful and failed runs distinguished.
No Paper B headline promoted from Paper A registration.

tasks.title: Approve selected roots and module ownership
tasks.obligation: Approve the narrow first release, full-paper extension sequence and source-size review thresholds.
acceptance: Selected root names, nonclaims, owners and zero-unreachable-module invariant approved as an architecture; exact typed signature approval follows PB0.4.
No implementation until this architecture decision is recorded.
The informal all-query/width/weighted scope is authorized; this does not substitute for approval of elaborated Lean signatures.

tasks.title: Elaborate a nonvacuous statement and cost surface
tasks.obligation: Type-check the actual graph, encoding, fixed solver/step and resource contracts before proving the headline.
acceptance: Challenge uses only allowed imports and explicit definitions.
Reject per-input hardcoded solver, arbitrary zero work, uncharged oracle and hidden average-case interpretation.
Exact signatures replace the design sketches in INTERFACES.md.
Record author approval of the final elaborated Challenge/release contract before any theorem proof begins.
The Challenge requires a full original-index Boolean vector; the OR is a derived projection, not the advertised correctness claim.

tasks.title: Pin and rehearse the supported environment
tasks.obligation: Select a supported Lean/Mathlib pair and bounded graph/data-structure library reuse; run a small clean pilot.
acceptance: Full commits, licenses and trusted Challenge dependency ancestry pinned.
Current floor checked; local legacy 4.33 environment is not reused silently.
No whole historical Controller import.

tasks.title: Define per-query reachability and the answer vector
tasks.obligation: Define valid inputs, per-query success and a complete vector indexed by original query IDs; define existential success as its OR.
acceptance: Length-zero path is allowed exactly at a surviving vertex.
Failed root/target, empty batch and empty target list specified.
Count target occurrences and stored arcs; distinguish set sensitivity from raw list size.

tasks.title: Normalize input while preserving every query answer
tasks.obligation: Return settled original-index answers plus an injectively mapped unresolved batch; positive normalization must continue.
acceptance: Both directions of answer equivalence and original-target correspondence.
All scans and reindexing charged to explicit input.
Legacy decreasing-rank edges are reindexed, not reversed.

tasks.title: Prove single-failure and domination semantics
tasks.obligation: Connect path-based domination, reflexive ancestry, failed targets and dominance-comparable failure pairs.
acceptance: Domination is restricted appropriately to initially reachable vertices.
Removing a dominated second failure changes no surviving answer.

tasks.title: Construct the dominator tree and LCA index
tasks.obligation: Prove predecessor-LCA insertion on a DAG and binary-lifting/Euler query implementation.
acceptance: Construction O((V+E) log(V+2)), O(V log(V+2)) words established in the cost model.
No assumed constant-time construction or free tree index.

tasks.title: Implement indices, answer maps and timestamp arrays
tasks.obligation: Implement target indexing, activity/deduplication arrays and original-index answer storage with charged initialization.
acceptance: Targets are indexed in O(q_b+M) work.
Array reset/epoch overflow and actual storage bounds are proved.
No search over all queries per vertex.

tasks.title: Vertex-split capacities and deletion correspondence
tasks.obligation: Build capacity-one gates and capacity-three transit/protected arcs with explicit reverse-arc identities.
acceptance: Original surviving paths correspond to split-network paths.
Parallel/reverse arcs cannot collapse identities.
At most O(V+E) network entries.

tasks.title: Bounded augmentation and max-cut certificate
tasks.obligation: Implement at most three unit augmenting searches and prove value-3 or maximum-value-2 alternatives.
acceptance: Residual capacity, conservation and cut certificates proved.
Search/decomposition workspace and all failed scans counted.
No unproved max-flow oracle premise in selected roots.

tasks.title: Decompose the two flow paths
tasks.obligation: Extract ordered paths and gate positions from the integral flow in the acyclic split network.
acceptance: Each unprotected unit gate is on at most one path.
Protected vertices may be shared; full vertex-disjointness is not assumed.

tasks.title: Compute residual path-rank labels
tasks.obligation: Construct SCC/condensation and propagate two minima to characterize residual reachability.
acceptance: Residual graph may be cyclic even though the input is a DAG.
Infinity/sentinel cases and reverse-path monotonicity exact.
O(V+E) total work/space, not repeated per-target reachability.

tasks.title: Prove arbitrary-target residual membership
tasks.obligation: Prove equation (3.1e) for every original target under a proper two-cut.
acceptance: Targets outside the anchor cone, the root, and failed vertices included.
Both directions of the union-of-residual-closures argument.

tasks.title: Recognize proper cuts at a proposed vertex
tasks.obligation: Prove necessity and sufficiency of all four inequalities (3.2b), including orientation rejection and flow-3 success.
acceptance: Requires failures disjoint from the anchor dominators.
No-cut classification yields a surviving prefix, not a batch answer without a suffix.

tasks.title: Join kernel correctness and construction resources
tasks.obligation: Export one implemented kernel with correctness and counted construction/evaluation costs.
acceptance: Build O(V+E), evaluate O(1) per target after preprocessing.
Graph scanning, flow, SCC, labels and reusable scratch included.
No caller-supplied answer table or kernel-running-time assumption.

tasks.title: Define the all-query reverse-topological scheduler
tasks.obligation: Implement vector answers, unknown/active state and historical light lists; record and retire positive and negative queries.
acceptance: Fixed program determined before individual inputs.
Effective threshold tau_eff=min(tau,q_prime+1); zero-query exits explicit.
Kernel interface may be a named provisional hypothesis only until PB4.5.

tasks.title: Maintain the surviving-suffix invariant
tasks.obligation: Each stored ID certifies a suffix to an original target avoiding its failures.
acceptance: Pulling across original arcs preserves the invariant.
Duplicate and stale labels have defined filter behavior.

tasks.title: Verify Resolve and positive/negative retirement
tasks.obligation: Resolve records YES via a certified surviving prefix or target, otherwise scans the entire original target list before recording NO; either answer retires its own query.
acceptance: Every call returns a definitive Boolean and retires only that query.
NO requires all original targets to fail; YES may use a surviving prefix and the certified suffix.
Record root arrivals and direct normalization positives without terminating the batch.
Every later candidate at one heavy vertex uses the same one live kernel.

tasks.title: Prove vector correctness, completeness and termination
tasks.obligation: Every recorded Boolean matches its own original query; no successful query remains active at the end; final unknown entries are NO.
acceptance: Prove forall original i, answer[i]=true iff Success(I,i).
Query-index map is injective and covers direct, resolved, root and final-negative cases exactly once.
No successful still-active query can survive the path-following completeness argument.

tasks.title: Ground the operational and live-space model
tasks.obligation: Implement the frozen instruction, execution and live-storage semantics before algorithm proofs consume them; expose concrete primitive events and encoded-word constraints.
acceptance: The model cannot grant arbitrary answers, ticks or peak-space fields to a candidate program.
Instruction steps, array/word operations and memory lifetime are concrete; algorithm-specific refinements are proved in their owner modules.
A fixed program or uniform program family precedes the individual input quantifier.
The Proposition 2.2 construction counters require an actual primitive-refinement bridge before its linear-time claim is accepted.

tasks.title: Amortize every completed kernel by retirement
tasks.obligation: Prove K*tau_eff<=q_prime for the all-query schedule; every kernel completes and there is no final-positive-kernel slack.
acceptance: Initial tau_eff buffered IDs are distinct and active; each is retired by this kernel.
Retirement sets of all kernels are disjoint; K<=floor(q_prime/tau_eff).
If threshold is capped above q_prime, no kernel is constructed.

tasks.title: Charge stale positive/negative labels and original targets
tasks.obligation: Prove every historical edge pull, including stale YES labels, is counted; a query enters Resolve at most once and all target scans total O(M).
acceptance: Edge-induced entries <=E(tau_eff-1), including stale positives and negatives.
Full target scans occur at most once per query; seeding and normalization are charged separately.
Deduplication, resets and adjacency scans are not hidden.

tasks.title: Prove peak words including complete answer storage
tasks.obligation: Bound all historical lists, output/ID maps, preprocessing, scratch and one live kernel in the concrete live-space model.
acceptance: Peak <= explicit C(S+V tau_eff) times a fixed polylog.
Workspace actually reused; no hidden list of all residual networks.
Integer counters, sentinels and allocations fit the chosen logarithmic word width.
Complete answer vector and original-index maps use O(q_b) words, absorbed by S; do not compute an individual-target table.

tasks.title: Close all-query Theorem 3.2 on original inputs
tasks.obligation: Join one fixed implemented vector solver with every-index correctness, total time and peak workspace; derive the existential projection without extra asymptotic cost.
acceptance: Uniform constants/polylog exponent independent of the input and tau.
Correct answer and both advertised total bounds in the same theorem cone.
No abstract kernel, dominator, SCC or primitive-cost premise remains.

tasks.title: Derive threshold corollaries and the existential projection
tasks.obligation: Prove cap/ceil/empty-batch specializations and OR aggregation, with resource corollaries in Solution to avoid an import cycle.
acceptance: Sparse E,q_b,M=O(V) gives soft-O(V^(3/2)) time.
No claim of near-linear unrestricted time or all query answers from an OR solver.
Derived root corollaries stay in Solution; Resources must not import Solution.

tasks.title: Represent immutable exact historical sets
tasks.obligation: Sort and intern actual ID tuples; define Lambda from all distinct nonempty retained historical tuples.
acceptance: Equality is deterministic exact comparison, not a hash-collision assumption.
Activity changes do not mutate shared tuples.

tasks.title: Refine the answer-vector scheduler through shared handles
tasks.obligation: Preserve every recorded answer and both retirement outcomes under exact immutable historical-set interning.
acceptance: Same complete original-index answer vector and per-query retirement decisions.
No assumption that overlapping sets are equal.

tasks.title: Close sharing time and space bounds
tasks.obligation: Prove dictionary/sort costs fit the original time bound and space is soft-O(S+Lambda).
acceptance: Lambda<=V(tau_eff-1), with all historically retained arrays counted.
Small graph/zero batch cases avoid invalid E>=V-1 absorption.
A balanced dictionary implementation or pinned proved realization supplies its costs.
Interning consumes generic Resources/Scheduler bounds, not Solution, avoiding a cycle when Solution later selects the sharing root.

tasks.title: Formalize the two representation families
tasks.obligation: Prove both all-m valid constructions and their V,E,q_b,M,S,Lambda formulas.
acceptance: Power-of-two and minimum-m assumptions literal.
Representation growth is not a universal space lower bound.
Example-only code stays outside the first release unless explicitly selected.

tasks.title: Sorted dead-region intersection and anchor recognition
tasks.obligation: Prove (3.1a)–(3.1c), shrinking seed-set updates, exact recognition and counted release queue.
acceptance: New seeds flagged before removed seeds can be released.
Each vertex/arc released once; sorting and target aggregation charged.
Rejecting an anchor does not return UNSAT/NO for the original batch.

tasks.title: Single-occurrence linear theorem
tasks.obligation: Implement candidate/terminal grouping and single-dominator ancestry queries.
acceptance: Semantic result may use a supplied tree, but full O(G) needs a proved exact-linear dominator construction.
Do not replace BGK linear time by Lengauer–Tarjan or binary lifting without changing the advertised bound.

tasks.title: Independent trees and deletion localization
tasks.obligation: Prove dead/fixed/symmetric-difference partition and unchanged dominators for fixed vertices, under the exact independent-tree hypothesis.
acceptance: Lemma 4.2 conditional inputs match its paper setup.
Tree construction/cost is separately discharged for Theorem 4.3.

tasks.title: Output-sensitive dominator updates and Sigma charge
tasks.obligation: Report subtree differences, maintain implicit unchanged parents and binary-lifting LCAs, and sum weighted work over a pair cover.
acceptance: Independent-tree construction is proved/imported at an audited pin.
Sigma identity and <=(V+E)min(|C|,2h) proved.
No all-vertex reset per deletion; all target costs charged.

tasks.title: Explicit-update obstruction and Hamiltonian cases
tasks.obligation: Prove the skip-DAG idom changes, every-cover lower bound, easy batch rule and p=1 recognition corollary.
acceptance: Every V>=12 and every independent-tree/cover choice quantified.
Obstruction concerns explicit updates only; no Boolean-batch lower bound.

tasks.title: Later-failure crossing and target compression
tasks.obligation: Prove the u<b<w crossing characterization and retain the last target per reachability chain.
acceptance: Chain connecting paths may be nonedges.
Suffix is safe only after the later failure.
R_star<=min(M,q_b p) and compression work O(S).

tasks.title: Streamed columns and original-edge range indexes
tasks.obligation: Implement one coordinate column and one edge index at a time, validate proposed chains and aggregate query extrema.
acceptance: Prove the full p(V+E), pR_star and q_b p log^2 V charges.
Keep original transitive arcs; no contraction producing spurious paths.
Near-linear workspace for every p; no small-p assumption in space theorem.

tasks.title: Construct width-aware greedy reachability chains
tasks.obligation: Define width as minimum reachability-chain partition size; prove the overlapping-cover equivalence, max-uncovered-path DP and discovery bounds.
acceptance: Algorithm does not receive kappa or an optimal partition.
For remaining U vertices some fixed kappa-cover path contains at least U/kappa; prove termination and p=O(kappa log(V+2)), including kappa=1.
Assign each vertex once to a selected path subsequence; storage O(V+E), all scans/iterations charged.

tasks.title: Compose constructed-width all-query bound
tasks.obligation: Feed the actually constructed partition to the streamed solver and close Corollary 4.7.
acceptance: Discovery plus validation plus p(V+E), pR_star and q_b p log^2 V fit soft-O(kappa*S).
Peak working words stay soft-O(S), without storing every overlapping full path or all coordinate columns.
No assertion that minimum disjoint edge-path count equals reachability width.

tasks.title: Verify linear-time weighted cover selection
tasks.obligation: Implement residual weights and one-pass primal-dual selection on the remaining pair graph.
acceptance: Zero weights, ties, duplicate edges and empty graphs covered.
Maintain dual feasibility and selected-vertex tightness; prove cost(C)<=2 OPT_c without computing OPT_c.
O(V+q_b) time/words; bounded integer weights and sums fit logarithmic word width.

tasks.title: Compose weighted region optimum bound
tasks.obligation: Compute subtree costs, identify Sigma(C)=sum c(u), and close Corollary 4.8 under the same fixed independent trees.
acceptance: Three bottom-up passes include weight discovery O(V+E).
For fixed B,R prove O((S+OPT_c)log(V+2)) time and O(S+Vlog(V+2)) space with all-query answers.
No exact optimum cover, global tree optimization, or free bipartite min-cut oracle is assumed.

tasks.title: Selectors, triangle and representation padding
tasks.obligation: Construct the shared-layer selector and triangle equivalence, with actual declared-label/incidence counts and padding.
acceptance: Guard multiplicity and forced-target conventions exact.
Semantic equivalence, size and construction time exported separately.
No copied shared layers hiding nG overhead.

tasks.title: Clique windows and fixed polynomial ratios
tasks.obligation: Prove cyclic tuple consistency for k=2c+1, b>=a and all window-pair checks.
acceptance: Every coordinate pair has cyclic distance <=c.
n=a^c+2, G=Theta(b^(c+1)) and construction time proved with fixed-c constants.
Integer rounding and every fixed gamma in (0,1) handled.

tasks.title: Copied-layer multiplicity tradeoff
tasks.obligation: Prove mu=s-h and size Theta(2^h p^2) for p=2^s.
acceptance: Endpoints h=0,h=s and s=0 are explicit.
No constant-mu superlinear lower bound inferred.

tasks.title: Directed-cycle reduction and essentiality
tasks.obligation: Build the layered cycle instance, preserve all incidences and prove its YES-essentiality/two-sided promise.
acceptance: k-Cycle quantifier order is forall epsilon exists k, not one fixed k for every epsilon.
Unused-label and inaccessible padding is counted; NO instances remain in the promise.

tasks.title: Fix algorithm models and conditional transfers
tasks.obligation: Give exact deterministic/log-word-RAM and source-hypothesis contracts; prove reduction closure and exponent-transfer inequalities.
acceptance: Combinatorial is not an unconstrained Boolean tag.
Conjectures are explicit hypotheses; proved construction inputs are not silently axiomatized.
Real asymptotic families, parameter promises and fixed constants preserve their quantifier order.

tasks.title: Balanced algebraic clique implication
tasks.obligation: Prove the large-clique grouping, exponent slack and rounding under precisely the F=omega hypothesis.
acceptance: Every fixed c>=2; no c=1 boundary claim.
Only deterministic conclusions unless randomized assumptions are independently supplied.

tasks.title: Guarded-path and linear OSR equivalence
tasks.obligation: Port the smallest B01 semantic cone, complete both explicit transformations, query counts and sensitivity equality.
acceptance: Common forced deletion performed once.
Healthy-zero condition, root deletion and repeated target labels handled.
Linear operation counters are not called RAM time until their implementation bridge is proved.

tasks.title: Baseline detector, dual-Horn and blocked bitsets
tasks.obligation: Reuse audited Paper A detector ingredients and prove bitset block semantics and streaming storage.
acceptance: Last partial word, unused labels and Q conventions exact.
Support masks are not incorrectly asserted nodewise truth on every forced-target input.
No all-block retention; no repeated scan hidden outside the bound.

tasks.title: Algebraic one-sided algorithm
tasks.obligation: Prove path-generating matrix identities, deleted-vertex correction, randomized nonzero test and hybrid search/minimum cost.
acceptance: Field size and total error bound over all terminal tests proved.
Matrix arithmetic cost and word/bit representation not conflated.
Algebraic matrix multiplication time requires a proved model interface, not only an identity.

tasks.title: Canonical summaries, shortcuts and equality queries
tasks.obligation: Prove farthest-cut summary existence/uniqueness, same-vertex shortcut preservation and listed summary-equality reduction.
acceptance: All failure sets of size <=2, including failed root and summary vertices.
Summary vertices may be outside the original port set.
Construction and streamed residual trees charged; summary discovery is not assumed near-linear.

tasks.title: Uniform capacity, Kraft and optimal budgets
tasks.obligation: Prove/import the actual preserver/anti-isolation input, vertex splitting, private-tree amplification, Kraft converse and total incidence optimum.
acceptance: Selectors may have cycles: do not apply a DAG-only theorem.
Until the external theorem is discharged, downstream results are explicitly conditional, not full formalization.
n=1, mu=0, zero budgets and non-power-of-two n covered; construction output size charged.

tasks.title: Shared Hitting Set reduction and construction cost
tasks.obligation: Prove shared-U Hitting Set equivalence, exact incidence-size bounds and actual construction cost, before applying conditional algorithm-model transfers.
acceptance: Empty requirements/candidates correct; shared U stored once.
Healthy-one falsification is distinct from the OSR path contract.
Explicit O_c(m log m) construction, not just semantic reduction.

tasks.title: Conditional Hitting Set and joint exponents
tasks.obligation: Compose the fully charged Hitting Set and clique reductions under their separate literal hypotheses.
acceptance: Preserve every epsilon, gamma and beta quantifier and size regime.
Match the O((n+q)G) upper bound using the same count conventions.

tasks.title: Physical and native-encoding application
tasks.obligation: Compose the published Paper A fault-image and guarded-decision interfaces with Paper B algorithms/reductions and native-size accounting.
acceptance: Source pins and selected Paper A declarations checked literally.
Supplied role annotations, one bus/one driver, native N=Theta(G), model lifting and physical witness output are separately charged.
No claim about arbitrary unannotated CNF or general 3-SAT.

tasks.title: Audit all-query statement fidelity and trust
tasks.obligation: Compare the frozen v1.1 statement with every-index correctness, the same solver in resource declarations, and exact dependency/trust closure.
acceptance: Correctness is per original index; time and space apply to the very same fixed vector program.
No sorryAx, native_decide trust extension, or project axiom in selected roots.
Paper all-size statement is not replaced by finite test evidence.

tasks.title: Clean replay, Comparator and negative controls
tasks.obligation: Build the immutable selected cone from a clean snapshot and run statement comparison and independent mandatory kernel rehearsals.
acceptance: Positive and deliberately invalid comparator/control cases checked.
No stale oleans, missing manifest or invisible local dependency.
Source headers, licenses and all public theorem axioms audited.

tasks.title: Extension fidelity and exact coverage status
tasks.obligation: Certify each additional paper claim only after its semantic, algorithmic and imported-input obligations close.
acceptance: Never count Question 6.2 as a missing proof.
A supported partial release is distinguished from whole-paper coverage.
No registered Paper A declaration automatically counts as a Paper B theorem.

tasks.title: Prepare the selected release and manual registry packet
tasks.obligation: Freeze the narrow exact proof cone, provenance, license, declarations and user-controlled registration handoff.
acceptance: No public push or registry state change without the applicable authorization.
Submission, kernel verification, registry review and registration have distinct statuses.
Adding 3.3 or other roots requires approved cone expansion and its own completed audit.

historical_reuse: Existing B01 evidence is indexed separately; it is not counted as new campaign closure.
plan_schema_note: Milestones group obligations, not sequential phases. Follow task dependencies and approved release contracts. DONE_PLAN is not proof acceptance.
next_action: PB0.3: review the revised architecture; then PB0.5/PB0.4 to pin a supported environment and approve the exact vector-output typed contract.
